City Council & Successor Agency Regular Meeting
AGENDA
la puente City Council & Successor Agency Regular Meeting
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
AUGUST 28, 2012
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Holloway, Klinakis, Argudo, House, and Lewis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION TO VOLUNTEERS ON PATROL:
Josephine Martinez, Sergio Espinoza, and Ruth Espinoza
PRESENTATION FROM THE AMERICAN CANCER SOCIETY
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
RECESS THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETING
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF JUNE 26, 2012
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting of June 26, 2012.
A-1 06-26-2012 Minutes CC Reg
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CHAPTER 3.36 (ANIMAL CONTROL ORDINANCE) OF TITLE 3 (PUBLIC SAFETY AND MORALS) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE CONCERNING THE DOG LICENSING FEE; AND CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION AMENDING FEES FOR DOG LICENSES IN THE CITY
It is recommended that the City Council:
1. Adopt the Ordinance, amending Chapter 3.36 (Animal Control Ordinance) of Title 3 (Public Safety and Morals) of the La Puente Municipal Code to concerning the dog licensing fee;
a. Read Ordinance by title only and waive further reading; and
b. Introduce the Ordinance
2. Open the public hearing concerning the dog licensing fee increase;
3. Receive public comment;
4. Adopt the Resolution amending the fees for dog licenses
B-1 Staff Report Animal Control Dog Licensing Fees
B-1 Staff Report Animal Control Dog Licensing Fees (Attachment A-Ordinance)
B-1 Staff Report Animal Control Dog Licensing Fees (Attachment B-Resolution)
B-1 Staff Report Animal Control Dog Licensing Fees (Exhibit A-Fee Study)
B-2
CONSIDERATION OF AN URGENCY ORDINANCE EXTENDING FOR 12 MONTHS THE TERMS AND PROVISIONS OF ORDINANCE NO. 11-920 ESTABLISHING A MORATORIUM ON THE ESTABLISHMENT, EXPANSION, OR RELOCATION OF NEW AND EXISTING MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENTS AND TECHNICIANS IN THE CITY
It is recommended that the City Council: It is recommended that the City Council: 1) Open the public hearing;
2) Take public testimony; 3) Close the public hearing; 4) Read ordinance by title only and waive further reading; and 4) Adopt Urgency Ordinance - An Urgency Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente Extending by an Additional 12 Months the Terms and Provisions of Ordinance No. 11-920 Establishing a Moratorium on the Establishment, Expansion or Relocation of New and Existing Massage Establishments and Technicians
B-2 Massage Moratorium Extension 1 Year - CC Staff Report
B-2 Massage Moratorium Extension 1 Year - Ord. - Attachment A
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
DISCUSS AND PROVIDE DIRECTION ON FINANCIAL ADVISORY SERVICES FOR THE PROPOSED ISSUANCE OF REFUNDING BONDS
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
C-1 CC. Finance Staff Report - Financial Advisory Services
C-2
DISCUSS AND PROVIDE DIRECTION REGARDING THE 2012 MAIN STREET RUN AND CONSIDERATION OF REGISTRATION FEE INCREASE
It is recommended that the Council either: 1) Direct Staff to conduct the 2012 Main Street Run including the proposed reductions in expenses and increased registration fees; or 2) Provide Staff other direction.
C-2 Main Street Run Staff Report
C-3
DISCUSS AND PROVIDE DIRECTION ON THE HEALTHY EATING ACTIVE LIVING RESOLUTION
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide Staff direction on drafting a Healthy Eating Active Living Resolution.
C-3 HEAL Staff Report
C-4
DISCUSS AND PROVIDE DIRECTION REGARDING LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF BADGES (City Manager to provide a verbal report at Council Meeting.)
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide staff direction.
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF AN AMENDMENT TO CONTRACT NO. 07-900 WITH HOGLE-IRELAND, INC. TO COMPLETE THE UPDATE OF THE CITY'S ZONING CODE IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $68,425.00
It is recommended that the City Council authorize an amendment to the City's contract with Hogle-Ireland, Inc. to complete the update of the City's Zoning Code in an amount not to exceed $68,425.
E-4 Staff Report Contract Award - Hogle-Ireland - Zoning Code Update 2012
E-4 Exhibit A - Hogle Resolution Zoning Code Update
E-4 Exhibit B - Hogle Resolution - Zoning Code Update
E-4 Exhibit C - Hogle Resolution - Zoning Code Update
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF A COMMUNITY GARDEN AT LA PUENTE PARK
It is recommended that the City Council review and discuss the report and provide direction to staff.
E-2
DISCUSS AND PROVIDE DIRECTION REGARDING THE CITY BEING NAMED AS THE LEAD PARTICIPANT CITY FOR BIKE SAN GABRIEL VALLEY'S HEALTHY EATING ACTIVE LIVING GRANT APPLICATION
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide Staff direction regarding the City being named as the Lead Participant City for Bike San Gabriel Valley's Healthy Eating Active Living grant application.
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION RESCINDING RESOLUTIONS 95-3709 AND
98-3942, AND ADOPTING COUNCIL POLICY CC - 6.1, SENIOR CENTER USE
It is recommended that the City Council adopt a resolution rescinding Resolution Nos. 95-3709 and 98-3942, and approve City Council Policy CC - 6.1, Senior Center Use contained in Attachment "A."
E-3 Rec Staff Report - Senior Center Use Policy
E-3 Rec Staff Report - Senior Center Use Policy (Attachment A - Resolution Adopting The Senior Use Policy)
E-3 Rec Staff Report - Senior Center Use Policy (Attachment B - Senior Center Use Guidelines)
E-3 Rec Staff Report - Senior Center Use Policy (Exhibit A -Senior Center Use Policy)
F.
CLOSED SESSION
F-1
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE 54957.6(f) TO CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS.  AGENCY DESIGNATED REPRESENTATIVES:  BRET M. PLUMLEE, CITY MANAGER; WARD KOMERS, DIRECTOR OF ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES; AND JAY TRINNAMAN, COUNSEL.  EMPLOYEE ORGANIZATIONS: CEA AND SEIU
F-2
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS INTO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54956.9(a), EXISTING LITIGATION:  LA PUENTE PROFESSIONALS, SUPERVISORS, MANAGERS AND CONFIDENTIAL EMPLOYEES ASSOCIATION ("LPPSMCEA") V. CITY OF LA PUENTE (CASE NO. LA-CE-744-M)
RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
AB 1234 REPORTS
C-2
DISCUSS AND PROVIDE DIRECTION REGARDING THE 2012 MAIN STREET RUN AND CONSIDERATION OF REGISTRATION FEE INCREASE
It is recommended that the Council either: 1) Direct Staff to conduct the 2012 Main Street Run including the proposed reductions in expenses and increased registration fees; or 2) Provide Staff other direction.
C-3
DISCUSS AND PROVIDE DIRECTION ON THE HEALTHY EATING ACTIVE LIVING RESOLUTION
It is recommended that the City Council discuss and provide Staff direction on drafting a Healthy Eating Active Living Resolution.
D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1324 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2011 - 2012 AND FISCAL YEAR 2012-2013
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolution approving Warrant Register No. 1324.
D-1 CITY WR# 1324
RECESS THE CITY COUNCIL AND RECONVENE THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING - None.
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS - None.
D.
CONSENT CALENDAR - None.
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING THE THIRD RECOGNIZED OBLIGATION PAYMENT SCHEDULE ("ROPS") COVERING THE PERIOD OF JANUARY 1, 2013 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2013
It is recommended that the Successor Agency adopt a resolution authorizing approval and transmittal of the third Recognized Obligation Payment Schedule covering the period of January 1, 2013 through June 30, 2013.
E-1 SA Staff Report-Amended ROPS#3 v2
E-1 SA Jan-Jun 2013 SA Reso Adopting ROPS - Attachment A
E-1 SA 8-13 January_to_June_2013_ROPS_Form - Exhibit A
ADJOURN THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY
RECONVENE THE CITY COUNCIL AND RECESS CITY COUNCIL INTO CLOSED SESSION

ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF

Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
